name: Astro API By Synilogic
author: synilogic

sections.description:
Astro API By Synilogic is a WordPress plugin that connects your site to the hosted Astro API By Synilogic service (https://synilogic.in) to generate astrological charts and reports. All API calls are made server-side so your API key is never exposed. The plugin includes Google Maps-based location autocomplete with timezone detection and supports multiple Indian languages.

Plugin slug: synilogic-jyotisham-astro

Features

  • Secure server-side API integration (keys never exposed to browser)
  • Google Maps location autocomplete with timezone detection
  • Multiple chart styles (North, South, East Indian)
  • Panchang, Choghadiya, Numerology, and Hora Muhurta
  • Kundli Matching (Ashtakoot, Dashakoot, Aggregate)
  • Shortcodes for easy embedding
  • Responsive UI

Shortcodes

  • [jyotisham_kundli]
  • [jyotisham_matching]
  • [jyotisham_panchang]
  • [jyotisham_choghadiya]
  • [jyotisham_numerology]
  • [jyotisham_hora]

Security

  • Nonce validation on all AJAX endpoints
  • Comprehensive input sanitization and validation
  • Server-side API key storage and usage

Privacy

This plugin sends birth details (provided by the user) to the Astro API By Synilogic service to fetch astrological results. No personal data is stored by the plugin beyond WordPress options for API keys. Review the service policies for data practices:

  • Privacy Policy: https://synilogic.in/privacy-policy
  • Terms of Service: https://synilogic.in/terms

Ownership: This plugin is developed and maintained by Synilogic.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the synilogic-jyotisham-astro folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from Plugins in WordPress.
  3. Go to Admin > Astro API By Synilogic and enter your API keys.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes. Obtain it from https://synilogic.in.

Does it require Google Maps?

Only for location autocomplete and timezone detection. Enter your Google Maps API key for this feature.
